_comment: **Named in a recipe, which is what seeds an Age's rock with lava tubes.** Its own page, split out of
`volcano` on 2026-09-11: naming the mountains and getting tubes in the bedrock as well meant a word
brought something it did not say. `volcanic` is the word that asks for all four together.
Seven passes a chunk over the whole height of the world. An ore feature is a no-op wherever it finds
no stone, so the full range costs a handful of misses rather than a rule about where rock is.
**The threshold filter is the whole of what keeps a cluster safe to find.** A cluster is enclosed by
the rock it is buried in, so opening one floods the space you opened; one that surfaced on a hillside
had nothing round it and welled a disc of lava standing proud of the land. Eight blocks of cover is
enough that nothing of the deepest blob reaches open sky. A cave breaks nothing -- a heightmap is the
top of the terrain, so a cluster under it can still be in a cavern wall, which is where they belong.
